dct_creator_sm: Turnbull, James (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. A physical map of the Lower Mainland of British Columbia including the coast down to Bellingham Bay in the United States. This map shows the existing roads, proposed roads, and roads in need of repair mostly located south of the Fraser River from New Westminster to Hope.
